title: Manage promotion and demotion process
goal: Every change of a person's role, level or pay has a written test it was judged against, a case the founder decided, and a people record showing the new role, terms, decision rights and effective date.

steps.do: Write what a move up or down turns on for each role: the competencies and their level, the decision rights it adds or removes from `governance/delegation`, and the pay range it moves into, so the same test is applied to everyone.

For a proposed move, set the person's recorded work against that test, name what changes in their decision rights and what it costs over a year, and give the founder the case alongside the alternative of leaving the role as it is.
Once the founder has decided and told the person, update `people` with the new role, terms and effective date, and name the change the delegation needs so the person's reach matches the role.
Open a decision for every proposed move the founder has not settled and for each delegation change a settled move requires, and tell the strategy lead which move the plan needs next.

done_criteria.check: Was every proposed move judged against the written test, with its yearly cost and its delegation change named?
